content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

Section 1 of the Master Services Agreement expressly negates exclusivity: "Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties." That directly satisfies the sole preferred element, so no redline is warranted.

I also cleared each other location where exclusivity could hide:
- p0002 — non-exclusive licence *to AP* (benefits us; not a covenant).
- p0023 — Kubient contracting with all Advertisers on AP's behalf: a default allocation of Kubient's duties, overridable by Exhibit and subject to AP's retained freedom in § 1; not a sourcing prohibition on AP.
- p0025 — use restrictions concern transfer/reverse engineering of the Service, not procurement from competitors.
- p0064/p0065/p0072/p0073 — "exclusive" used for forum, trademark ownership, entire agreement and third-party beneficiaries.

No requirements-purchase, sole-source, right-of-first-refusal, or "shall not procure from any third party" language exists anywhere in the document.
